Question Choices: Select. Is every rhombus a square? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Four right angles are also needed for a square.
Solution: No. A rhombus can have four equal sides and angles 60°,120°,60°,120°. It lacks the four right angles needed for a square or rectangle.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has all sides the same length and opposite sides parallel, but its angles are not right angles. What is it called? ~~Rectangle | Square | Rhombus | Trapezoid~~
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Four right angles are also needed for a square.
Solution: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Without four right angles it is neither a rectangle nor a square.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A shape has 4 sides and 2 pairs of parallel sides. What is the most specific name for this shape family? ~~Parallelogram | Trapezoid~~
Solution: A quadrilateral with two pairs of parallel opposite sides is a parallelogram. Extra side or angle restrictions are not given.

Question Choices: Select the correct option. A square has four right angles and all sides equal. This shape belongs to which of the following families? ~~Rectangle | Rhombus | Parallelogram | All-above~~
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: A square has four equal sides and four right angles. Therefore it is a rectangle, a rhombus, a parallelogram and a quadrilateral. All three listed broader families apply.

Question Choices: A metalworker crafts a custom window frame with 4 straight sides. The frame is built to have exactly one pair of parallel sides to fit into a sloped roofline. What is this shape called? : Parallelogram Trapezoid Rectangle Rhombus
Solution: Exactly one parallel pair makes this a trapezoid. A parallelogram, rectangle or rhombus has two parallel pairs.
